0022600107.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-0) host the Houston Rockets (2-0) in Atlanta's third game of the 2026-27 season. The Hawks are 1st in the Southeast and 1st in the East, and their two wins both came on the road, while the Rockets are 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Houston is missing Fred VanVleet (knee), Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (ankle). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and Houston swept Atlanta 0-2 in the 2025-26 season series, including a 117-95 win in Houston on 2026-03-20.
